reviews.text: excellent work! reasonable pricing. We had absolutely no issues with how the stump was removed. Looks like there was never a tree there. Highly recommend
reviews.author: Maryann E.

reviews.text: Rubios is by far the best in the area and very reasonably priced. When I bought the house, I knew I was taking on a huge project and Rubio’s was there every step of the way to help guide me through it.
reviews.author: Eileen B.

reviews.text: If you need any kind of tree work done, I recommend calling Rubio’s Tree Service! They have removed and trimmed up several trees for me and grinded a couple of stumps as well. They have responded very quickly when a couple of trees have fallen from storms.
reviews.author: Andrew J.
